member.name: T:Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Razor.Completion.Delegation.ImplicitExpressionSuggestionModeRewriter
member.summary: Manages completion behavior for C# completions at the top level of implicit Razor expressions.
member.remarks:
This rewriter handles two cases:
1. **At the @ transition** (cursor immediately after @): clears all commit characters and sets IsIncomplete = true. This prevents characters like { from committing a completion item when the user intends @{ (a code block). The IsIncomplete flag ensures the client re-queries on the next keystroke, restoring normal commit behavior.
2. **At the top level of the implicit expression** (e.g., @h|): clears false-positive . In implicit expressions, the Razor compiler generates C# like __builder.AddContent(seq, h). Because RenderTreeBuilder.AddContent has a RenderFragment (delegate) overload, Roslyn's suggestion-mode completion provider detects a potential lambda context and enables suggestion mode. This is a false positive—users almost always intend to reference an identifier, not start a lambda.
However, implicit expressions can contain nested method calls with balanced parentheses (e.g., @items.Where(x => x.Name)), where suggestion mode from the inner method's delegate parameter is legitimate. Case 2 only clears suggestion mode when the cursor is at the top level of the implicit expression (not inside parentheses).

member.remarks: We use character scanning rather than Razor syntax tree inspection because the Razor parser treats all C# content in an implicit expression as a single flat CSharpExpressionLiteralSyntax token.
